description: Port Botany Efficiency is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Transport for NSW. The dashboard below measures show the performance of various operational aspects within Port Botany as well as container throughput and vessel arrivals. Coverage is Australia, 2016 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
